name: Luxembourg: Haunted Castles & Ghost Legends — Beaufort, Esch-sur-Sûre & Useldange
tagline: Private evening tour of three castle ruins in Luxembourg, told through local ghost legends by a storyteller-guide and chauffeur
overview:
This is a private four-hour tour of three castle ruins in Luxembourg, structured around local ghost legends rather than a conventional historical narration. A storyteller-guide and chauffeur take you by premium car or SUV from Luxembourg City to Beaufort Castle, Esch-sur-Sûre Castle and Useldange Castle, and back. GetYourGuide describes the experience as 'not a jump-scare experience but an immersive journey through history, folklore and atmosphere', and it is designed for the darker months of the year.

Each stop comes with its legend, as the guide tells it: at Beaufort, whispers of a tragic noblewoman; at Esch-sur-Sûre, a castle said to be haunted by the restless spirits of its defenders; and at Useldange, the legend of the Black Knight and his spectral horses in the nearby woods.

The tour is private, for your group only, for up to 8 people, and the guide speaks English, Russian and Ukrainian. The price is from €1,140 per group of up to 4; larger groups may cost more. Pickup is in Luxembourg City (details confirmed at booking), admission to Beaufort Castle is included and meals are not. Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before. This is a new tour on GetYourGuide.

itinerary.description: Pickup in Luxembourg City (details confirmed at booking). The guide-narrator and chauffeur drive you in a premium car or SUV to the first stop, about 40 minutes away.

Beaufort Castle was established around 1050 and expanded through the 12th and 13th centuries. A Renaissance château was built alongside it in the 16th and 17th centuries, and the medieval castle gradually fell into ruin after the 17th century. On this tour the guide tells the legend of Beaufort, whispers of a tragic noblewoman. Admission to the castle is included. Beaufort Castle's ruins are open to visitors from April to October; outside that season, check with the operator what the Beaufort stop includes.

The ruins of Esch-sur-Sûre Castle stand on a hilltop above the Sûre river gorge. According to the tour description, the castle is said to be haunted by the restless spirits of its defenders, and the guide tells the story at the site.

Useldange Castle is a ruined castle in the village of Useldange, about 30 km northwest of Luxembourg City. The guide tells the legend of the Black Knight and his spectral horses, said to ride in the nearby woods. The tour then returns to Luxembourg City.

tips: The price is from €1,140 per group of up to 4 people, not per person, and larger groups may cost more. For a couple that is about €570 each; for a party of four, about €285 each.
The tour is designed for the darker months of the year, and the legends are told after dark.

Beaufort Castle is also on the Vianden, Beaufort and Echternach day tour ([Luxembourg: Vianden Castle, Beaufort Ruins & Medieval Echternach](/tours/luxembourg/luxembourg-vianden-beaufort-castles-tour)), a full-day sightseeing itinerary in a shared group. The two tours share only Beaufort and can be taken in either order.

faqs.question: Are there haunted castles in Luxembourg?
faqs.answer: Luxembourg has no single 'haunted house' attraction; these castle legends are the closest thing, and this tour visits three of them after dark. At Beaufort the guide tells of whispers of a tragic noblewoman, at Esch-sur-Sûre of a castle said to be haunted by the restless spirits of its defenders, and at Useldange of the Black Knight and his spectral horses in the nearby woods.

faqs.question: Is this a scary haunted-house experience?
faqs.answer: No. GetYourGuide describes it as 'not a jump-scare experience but an immersive journey through history, folklore and atmosphere'. The guide tells each legend at its castle, and the tour is designed for the darker months of the year.

faqs.question: Who was the Black Knight of Useldange?
faqs.answer: A local legend of a black knight riding with spectral horses in the woods near Useldange, told by the guide at the castle.

faqs.question: How does this compare to the Luxembourg Vianden/Beaufort/Echternach tour?
faqs.answer: The Vianden, Beaufort and Echternach tour is a full-day sightseeing itinerary in a shared group, while this tour is a private ghost-legends tour of about four hours. They share only Beaufort Castle.

faqs.question: How many people can join, and is pickup included?
faqs.answer: The tour is private, for your group only, for up to 8 people. The price is from €1,140 per group of up to 4, and larger groups may cost more. Pickup is in Luxembourg City (details confirmed at booking).

faqs.question: Is the guide available in languages other than English?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tour is available in English, Russian and Ukrainian. Specify your preferred language when booking.
